tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (site, app).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Note body, cards, tables.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Bylines, dates, captions, chart sources.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and table rows. Borders, never shadows.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Dualis indigo (Thierry 2026-11-06: a purple close to a very professional dark blue), the ONE brand colour: logo, headings, page bands, buttons, closing band.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: long
tokens.usage: Bull side: LONG tag, upside, positive moves. Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: short
tokens.usage: Bear side: SHORT tag, downside, negative moves. Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: long-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the bull column and LONG tag.

tokens.name: short-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the bear column and SHORT tag.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Same as brand since 2026-11-06 (Thierry: one colour everywhere, the old light purple CTA was too light): Subscribe button, active tab, step dots.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of brand and accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Featured plan background, light indigo tints.

tokens.name: chart-bg
tokens.usage: Chart ground, both themes: Thierry's black Note charts.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Faint horizontal gridlines; baseline one step lighter (#444).

tokens.name: chart-text
tokens.usage: Legend and value labels on points and bars.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Axis labels, benchmark text.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Main series on the black chart: bars (rounded 4px tops) and the main line, the brand indigo lightened to read on black.

tokens.name: chart-bar-muted
tokens.usage: Benchmark or comparison series.

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Second series as a line with dots (right axis).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Strip items, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a note.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page sections on the site.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Header strip, tables, note body. Institutional, square by default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: LONG/SHORT tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.
